works.title: Selling the Poor on Spending Like They're Rich: Plutonomy, Premiumization, and Social Media
works.description: Opinion essay analyzing wealth concentration, premiumization of consumer goods, and how social media pressure drives middle-class spending patterns through luxury consumption signals. Develops argument about the modern Gilded Age and distributional inequality.
works.quote: We are living in a new Gilded Age... wealthy monopolists like bank tycoons and railroad barons saw their fortunes boom as the country industrialized, while the poor... [continue to be squeezed]

works.title: Book Outline Restructuring Project: Knowledge Architecture Chapters

Executing substantial surgical edits including chapter consolidation, renumbering, and cross-reference corrections throughout the manuscript.
works.quote: I'll build this as a complete restructured document. Given the size (~3,200 lines with extensive surgical changes throughout), I'll copy the original and work through systematic edits.

works.title: Public Domain Publishing Venture: Business Naming and Strategy
works.description: Development of a publishing company focused on public-domain works with no rights reserved. User is creating naming strategy, exploring search keywords, and designing a gift-economy business model with optional donations and minimal markups, targeting users seeking freely available cultural content.
works.quote: I'm looking for a name for a publishing company I'm starting. It's going to be my brand. I plan to publish everything in the public domain with no rights reserved on any of it.
